public_rationale: Vectara's November 2025 hallucination leaderboard found that leading reasoning models still hallucinated. GPT-5, Claude Sonnet 4.5, Grok-4 and DeepSeek-R1 were all above 10%, and the just-released Gemini 3 Pro was at 13.6%. A February 2026 survey by Caltech/Stanford-affiliated authors found that significant reasoning failures persist 'even in seemingly simple scenarios.' That fits the plain reading of 'boneheaded errors.' Both parts of the claim hold for the period.
limitations: Hallucination rates depend on the benchmark; summarization tasks are one setting.
'Boneheaded' has no threshold; the support rests on documented failures on simple tasks.
